items.title: Use Codex skill invocation instead of unsupported slash commands
items.note: Roadmap now opens correctly from Codex using its native skill picker.

items.title: Consolidate Codex hooks into config.toml
items.note: Codex starts cleanly without duplicate hook configuration warnings.

items.title: Audience leak guard: DEMOTE tier for developer/API-surface work + lint gate when explicitly setting audience public
items.note: The changelog now warns before developer-facing work (API keys, posting APIs, admin tooling) slips into the public notes.

items.title: Worktree-aware serve/orient: detect git worktrees, warn when dashboard serves a stale branch's roadmap vs main checkout
Combined all-worktrees view as the serve dashboard default
Live worktree re-discovery in serve — added/deleted checkouts update the dashboard
Serve reprints unchanged status on every file touch — skip identical payloads
Auto-release nudge: when current version hits 100%, prompt or auto-run roadmap release before starting next version
items.note: Finished versions get cut automatically: when every item in the current version is done, the roadmap offers (or runs) the release for you before new work starts.

items.title: Internal notes can leak into the public changelog: unset-audience bugs default public and demote tells only advise
items.note: The public changelog is now protected: unclassified work stays in the internal log, saving a public note requires an explicit audience, and internal-sounding wording is refused at save time.

items.title: Typed human-readable ID prefixes (TSK-42, BUG-7) as display layer over int ids
items.note: Items now show friendly typed IDs like FEAT-12 and BUG-7 in status and next — and you can reference them either way when marking work done.

items.title: Acceptance criteria section as first-class part of plan templates
items.note: Plan templates now include an Acceptance section so reviews check work against explicit pass/fail criteria.

items.title: Filtered listing and search: status --type/--version filters, plus search and stats subcommands
items.note: Find things faster: filter status by type or version, and search titles, notes, and plans from the CLI.

items.title: promote leaves the incubator notes-link text in the promoted item title and slug
Version date stamped once and never re-stamped when the version reopens
Schema-validated install manifest + CI validate script for cross-agent installs
Completion-promise gate: parent greps an explicit done marker before allowing check
Per-role model mapping setting for the quality-first build loop
Split roadmap discipline rules into individually loadable principle skills
Release flow should bump or warn about the skill VERSION file in this repo
Tabbed serve dashboard: Roadmap, Ideas, Changelog views
items.note: The live dashboard now has tabs — browse your roadmap, the Idea Incubator, and the changelog without leaving the page.

items.title: Antigravity agy plugin packaging and CLI installer support
items.note: Antigravity users can now install the roadmap and agent tools as native plugins, with the same commands and hooks as everywhere else.

items.title: Haiku-first cost tiers: re-tier the agent fleet and slim the quality build loop
Sole-writer fallback for AI coders without native subagents
Mixed-model review: verifier on sonnet, opus or cross-provider second pass for high-risk steps
Review-effort and cache-stable briefs: verifier sonnet/high, read-only tool scopes, inline plan bodies, diff-scoped re-verification
Parallel-safe roadmap builds: per-item worktrees, fresh-session orchestration, pending-decision handoff and per-item token spend
items.note: Respawn budget set to 4 respawns per step (5 attempts total). After that the step is BLOCKED and written to the handoff note.

releaseNotes.0.17.0: Trust, but verify: finished steps can now carry proof of the tests that passed, release dates always match when work really wrapped, and your setup stays tidy across every AI coder you use.
releaseNotes.0.18.0: A roomier dashboard and a sharper crew. The live roadmap page now has tabs for your plan, your idea incubator, and your changelog. Antigravity joins the list of supported coders with native plugins. Behind the scenes, the review crew got cheaper and more careful: a different model now checks each change at full attention, and every helper gets exactly the tools its job needs. Happy shipping.
